speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Cachexia secondary to an undetected malignancy or chronic systemic infection.

Despite normal initial labs and CT scans, your significant unintentional weight loss of 18.1 kg over six months combined with persistent fatigue and malaise is highly concerning for occult disease. I will proceed with a focused physical examination of your lymph nodes, abdomen, and neurologic status to look for subtle signs of metastasis or chronic infection that may have been missed on imaging.
